article.title: Should the U.S. destroy its stockpile of ivory?
article.excerpt: Here is one of the latest developments in economic policy: The US government hopes to send a crushing message to anyone involved in the illegal ivory trade — by decimating a 6-ton stockpile of seized elephant ivory.
